source.publication: 2025 Oklahoma Resident Individual Income Tax Forms and Instructions (Form 511 packet)
source.section: Form 511 lines 1-14 and 18 (PDF pages 42-43); select line instructions (PDF pages 9-10); standard deduction line 10 (PDF page 10); exemptions line 11 and the Regular exemption terms (PDF pages 8 and 10); Tax Table (PDF pages 27-38)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 48,750.00 = 48,750.00. Federal taxable income = 48,750.00 - standard deduction 23,625.00 = 25,125.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Oklahoma starts from federal AGI). Form 511: line 1 federal AGI 48,750.00; line 2 subtractions 0.00; line 3 = 48,750.00 - 0.00 = 48,750.00; line 4 out-of-state income 0.00; line 5 48,750.00; line 6 additions 0.00; line 7 Oklahoma AGI 48,750.00; line 8 adjustments 0.00; line 9 48,750.00; line 10 standard deduction (head of household) 9,350.00; line 11 exemptions: 1 Regular + 0 Special = 1 x 1,000.00 = 1,000.00 (no one is 65 or older, 0 Special); line 12 = 9,350.00 + 1,000.00 = 10,350.00; line 13 taxable income = 48,750.00 - 10,350.00 = 38,400.00; line 14 tax (the projection's brackets as numbers; the booklet prints only a table and worksheets): 0.25% x 2,000.00 = 5.0000 + 0.75% x 3,000.00 = 22.5000 + 1.75% x 2,500.00 = 43.7500 + 2.75% x 2,300.00 = 63.2500 + 3.75% x 4,600.00 = 172.5000 + 4.75% x 24,000.00 = 1,140.0000; total 1,447.0000 = 1,447.00. Line 13 is under 100,000, so the form reads the tax table: row 38,400-38,450, column 'Married filing joint or head of household', PDF page 31, gives 1,448; expected keeps the schedule figure. Lines 15-17 credits 0.00; line 18 income tax 1,447.00. Head of household takes 9,350.00 and the table's second column, not the single one. No dependents in the inputs; the form would add 1,000.00 for each.
accepted_approximations: The brackets are derived from the printed tax table and the 100,000-and-over worksheets; the booklet prints no schedule. Below 100,000 tax is figured on the exact income, where the booklet taxes each 50-dollar row at its midpoint and rounds. At 100,000 and over the single and separate worksheet starts from 4,562 where the schedule gives 4,561.50.
The blind and dependent exemptions and the credits are left out (not_modelled).
